FIXUP: FROMLIST: remoteproc: mt8183: add reserved memory manager API 0day reports: drivers/remoteproc/mtk_scp.c:374:2: note: in expansion of macro 'dev_info' drivers/remoteproc/mtk_scp.c:375:4: warning: format '%llx' expects argument of type 'long long unsigned int', but argument 3 has type 'phys_addr_t {aka unsigned int}' [-Wformat=] drivers/remoteproc/mtk_scp.c:403:4: warning: format '%llx' expects argument of type 'long long unsigned int', but argument 3 has type 'unsigned int' [-Wformat=] The actual parameters are of type phys_addr_t, so we should really use %pa to display it. However, %pa expects a _pointer_ to the address, not the address itself, as parameter. Since the displayed value is often the result of a calculation, and not just an address, we can not consistently use %pa. Use typecasts to unsigned long long instead. CRAS: iodev - Protect ext_module by pipline lock When web app enables APM in CRAS, the active playback or echo reference iodev will have APM run as one of the modules in its dsp pipeline. There's a special case when using BT headset that when it gets disconnected, the silent playback device is activated and configured to run APM in audio thread because the BT iodev cannot do I/O anymore Later when main thread handles the event from bluetoothd to remove BT iodev, the silent playback device gets configured to run APM again. And that could cause crash because the cras_apm_reverse_module is being accessed by two threads. To fix that, move ext_dsp_module->configure call to between the get/put call of dsp pipeline so the mutex protects it from being accessed by two threads at the same time. BUG=chromium:970165 TEST=Apply full patch series, launch appr.tc and connect LG HBS700 headset. In bluetooth settings UI, repeatedly connect/disconnect headset 20-30 times to verify CRAS doesn't crash. Change-Id: Ia10d9135ee775e2d14017a09bfc0f429ab4dc364 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1647213 Commit-Ready: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Cheng-Yi Chiang <cychiang@chromium.org>

CRAS: dsp - NULL ext_dsp_module should set into pipeline When web app uses CRAS APM and the playback iodev switches, the cras_apm_reverse_module would detach and attach to different dsp pipelines of the iodev used as echo reference. There is a bug that when swtich playback away from iodev X, the sink module of dsp pipeline still points to the APM module for a short while before it closes. At this moment, main thread configures iodev Y by attaching the same APM module to its dsp pipeline, and that could cause crash. To fix this problem, modify the API to set NULL ext_dsp_module into the DSP pipeline/module layer, to ensure that it doesn't leak or be used in two thread simultaneously. BUG=chromium:970165 TEST=Apply full patch series, launch appr.tc and use LG HBS700 headset. In bluetooth settings UI, repeatedly connect/disconnect headset for 20 times to verify CRAS doesn't crash. arc: net: Allow multicast forwarder to start with layer 3 information This patch changes arc-networkd multicast forwarders so that they can be instantiated and bound to a device without layer 3 knowledge. When the IPv4 address of the outbound physical interface is needed during forwarding, it is always queried from the interface and never cached. This allows the forwarders to work when the network connection on top of a particular network interface is not yet ready when the forwarders are started. This also allows the forwarders to keep working when IPv4 provisioning changes. To support joining a multicast group on an interface without any IP address bound, the newer struct ip_mreqn is used in conjunction with the interface index for the setsockopt IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP system call. BUG=b:112661642 BUG=b:134713711 TEST=1) multinet off, eth0 and wlan0 connected: logged in, checked that switching the default network in shill triggers the multicast forwarders to switch. Packets are forwarded correctly. 2) multinet off, only wlan0 connected: logged in and out while also disabling and enabling WiFi. Checked that the multicast forwarders always recover once layer 3 is provisioned on WiFi. 3) multinet on, eth0 and wlan0 connected: same tests as 2). Change-Id: I61f3f88f29d490a0cd159fc5cac10c4b0b9fe52f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1648542 Commit-Ready: Hugo Benichi <hugobenichi@google.com> Tested-by: Hugo Benichi <hugobenichi@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hugo Benichi <hugobenichi@google.com>

crash: Don't count failed crash sends in rate limit Crash reporter has always written out a timestamp file before it sends a crash as a way of tracking how many crashes were sent in a 24 hours period. However, if that send fails for any reason, it still goes toward that count. This fixes that problem so we only count crashes that successfully uploaded in that limit. UPSTREAM: arm64: perf: Fix callchain parse error with kernel tracepoint events For ARM64, when tracing with tracepoint events, the IP and pstate are set to 0, preventing the perf code parsing the callchain and resolving the symbols correctly. ./perf record -e sched:sched_switch -g --call-graph dwarf ls [ perf record: Captured and wrote 0.146 MB perf.data ] ./perf report -f Samples: 194 of event 'sched:sched_switch', Event count (approx.): 194 Children Self Command Shared Object Symbol 100.00% 100.00% ls [unknown] [.] 0000000000000000 The fix is to implement perf_arch_fetch_caller_regs for ARM64, which fills several necessary registers used for callchain unwinding, including pc,sp, fp and spsr . With this patch, callchain can be parsed correctly as follows: ...... + 2.63% 0.00% ls [kernel.kallsyms] [k] vfs_symlink + 2.63% 0.00% ls [kernel.kallsyms] [k] follow_down + 2.63% 0.00% ls [kernel.kallsyms] [k] pfkey_get + 2.63% 0.00% ls [kernel.kallsyms] [k] do_execveat_common.isra.33 - 2.63% 0.00% ls [kernel.kallsyms] [k] pfkey_send_policy_notify pfkey_send_policy_notify pfkey_get v9fs_vfs_rename page_follow_link_light link_path_walk el0_svc_naked ....... Signed-off-by: Hou Pengyang <houpengyang@huawei.com> Acked-by: Will Deacon <will.deacon@arm.com> Signed-off-by: Catalin Marinas <catalin.marinas@arm.com> (cherry picked from commit 5b09a094f2fb768c76c8d4a82503df6fc7e1df63) BUG=b:132086052 TEST=Run CtsSimpleperfTestCases Change-Id: I829f552b74cbfd05768d9d1a340f2b7551c386d6 Signed-off-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1642707 Commit-Ready: Kazuhiro Inaba <kinaba@chromium.org> Tested-by: Shao-Chuan Lee <shaochuan@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shao-Chuan Lee <shaochuan@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>
